reuse_first_rules: Wrap existing action preview, workflow, safe-write preview, sandbox, and verification runner surfaces.
Do not create a disconnected motor-cortex executor.
Do not treat preview readiness as execution authority.
Do not let execution preview override Phase 6 product behavior truth.

adapters.role: Classify action, route type, target, and human approval requirement.
Preview workflow transitions and approval context reasons.
adapters.phase_7_constraint: No durable state or execution authority.

adapters.role: Preview pause, resume, cancel, timeout, and retry controls.
Preview append-only events and receipt requirements.
Preview path policy, proof requirements, rollback, and receipt requirements.
Preview exact allowlisted verification argv and blocked command reasons.
Reference sandbox capabilities and command presets for future approved execution.
Require behavior verifier gate before any execution-ready recommendation.
adapters.phase_7_constraint: No execution preview may convert Phase 6 FAIL into PASS.

handoff_constraints: Phase 8 may integrate dry-run outputs across phases but must not run providers, workers, safe writes, sandbox commands, or execute-approved routes unless separately approved.
Phase 8 must preserve Phase 6 product PASS gating.
Phase 8 must report unavailable checks as UNVERIFIED, not PASS.
